Login with email, password, optional MFA & device fingerprint
post.description:
Authenticates the user and issues:
- an **accessToken** (JWT, 15 min)
- a **refreshToken** (rotating, bound to the device fingerprint)

**Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**  
• If user has 2FA enabled, `mfaToken` is required  
• Without `mfaToken`, returns `206` status requesting 2FA code  
• With valid `mfaToken`, completes login normally  

**Fields**  
• `email`: your registered email  
• `password`: your account password  
• `mfaToken`: 6-digit code from authenticator app (required if 2FA enabled)  
• `deviceFingerprint`: a unique string identifying this device

message.example: Please enter your two-factor authentication code

401.description: Email not found, password incorrect, invalid 2FA code, or not verified

post.summary: Request a signup or login magic link
post.description:
Sends a one-time magic link to the given email address.  
- **Sign-in** (existing user): `email` + `deviceFingerprint` required.  
- **Sign-up** (new user): `fullName` & `role` also required.  
- Link expires in 10m, must be opened from same IP/browser.  
- Always returns `200 OK` to prevent email enumeration.

200.description: Link sent if email is registered or created

400.description: Missing required fields (e.g. deviceFingerprint or fullName)

503.description: Temporary email‐send failure, please try again later

post.summary: Generate MFA setup data (QR code and secret)
post.description:
Generates a new TOTP secret and QR code for setting up two-factor authentication.

**Response includes:**
- QR code as data URL for easy scanning
- Manual entry key for manual setup
- Secret for verification
- Backup codes for account recovery

**Important:** Save the backup codes securely before enabling MFA!

Enables two-factor authentication after verifying the setup with a test code.

**Steps:**
1. Call `/auth/mfa/setup` to get QR code and secret
2. Scan QR code with authenticator app
3. Generate 6-digit code from app
4. Call this endpoint with code and secret to enable MFA

**Security:** Once enabled, all future logins will require the 6-digit code.

400.description: Invalid verification code or MFA already enabled

value.error: Verification code and secret are required

post.description:
